title: Quasi-coherent modules under an affine morphism
statement: Let $u:U\to X$ be an affine morphism [pqf-def-affine-morphism] of schemes [def-pc-scheme] and write $\mathcal A=u_*\mathcal O_U$. The pushforward functor identifies quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_U$-modules with quasi-coherent $\mathcal A$-modules on $X$, with quasi-inverse $\mathcal M\mapsto u^*\mathcal M\otimes_{u^*\mathcal A}\mathcal O_U$. Quasi-coherence as an $\mathcal A$-module is equivalent to quasi-coherence as an $\mathcal O_X$-module. Here quasi-coherence and finite type over a sheaf of algebras mean locally a presentation by free modules and locally a surjection from a finite free module, respectively [pqf-def-coherent].
